content.short: UniSat is a leading open-source wallet and marketplace for BRC-20 and Ordinals on the Bitcoin network.
content.description: UniSat is a revolutionary Bitcoin-native platform designed to empower users by providing a secure and intuitive gateway to the emerging BRC-20 and Ordinals ecosystems. As a pioneer in Bitcoin-based asset management, UniSat offers a comprehensive suite of tools for minting, discovering, and trading unique digital collectibles directly on the Bitcoin blockchain. The platform's integrated marketplace ensures deep liquidity and transparent price discovery for Ordinals, while its self-custody wallet ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys. UniSat focuses on fostering a vibrant and innovative community, serving as a critical discovery layer for the next generation of Bitcoin utility and digital ownership.
content.meta: UniSat is the leading wallet and marketplace for Bitcoin Ordinals and BRC-20, offering secure asset management and decentralized trading.
